title: testmap selects test_selfdoc's tools-map test for a change to any _tools Python file
goal: testmap.py select maps a change to any _tools/*.py file (test files included) to _tools/test_selfdoc.py::TestSelfdocToolsMap, so the gate's tests.py --changed runs the map test whatever tool file a push changes; a test in test_testmap.py plants a change to a test file and sees the map test selected
